title: SHEIN referral code: where to enter it and how it works

description: Where to enter the SHEIN referral code (in the search bar, not the coupon field), a step-by-step with screenshots, what shows up after the search, what changed since the old 2024 program and how to get your own code.
metaDescription: The SHEIN referral code goes in the search bar, not the coupon field. See the step-by-step with screenshots, what it opens, what changed in 2024 and how to get yours.

contentSections.heading: Quick answer
paragraphs: The SHEIN referral code goes in the store's search bar, in the app or on the website on your phone, not in the coupon field. It does not give a fixed discount: it opens the page of the person who shared the code, with the offers the store shows there. 4CW5Y is Cecília's code; the step-by-step is below.

postParagraphs: Don't use the code as a coupon: it goes in the search box.

contentSections.heading: What shows up after the search and what you get
paragraphs: When you search for an affiliate's code, you see their selection page, SHEIN says. If the person who shared the code hasn't picked products yet, SHEIN's default selection page appears. On October 12, 2026, searching for 4CW5Y opened a recommendations page titled "Acho que você pode gostar".

There is no fixed discount tied to the code. If you arrive through the affiliate, you may get the perks shown on campaign or product pages, which are updated often. The campaigns currently running are on the SHEIN page here on the site.

links.label: See the 4CW5Y referral code and SHEIN's campaigns

postParagraphs: For the purchase to count for the person who shared the code, SHEIN says the order must be completed within 24 hours of the search or click, and the last code or link used applies. The commission doesn't raise what you pay.

contentSections.heading: Why the old guides, with the old program's coupon, no longer apply
paragraphs: Many guides and videos still describe the affiliate program that SHEIN ended on August 29, 2024. Under it, anyone using an affiliate's code got a discount coupon. SHEIN deactivated those codes, and the coupon ended with them.

In the current program, there is no longer a link between the person who refers and the person who uses the code. The code only leads to the affiliate's page, and the perks are those of the campaigns shown there.

contentSections.heading: How to get your own referral code
paragraphs: The referral code comes from SHEIN's affiliate program. To sign up, search for "afiliado" in the SHEIN app and verify an Instagram, YouTube or TikTok account that meets the program's requirements, such as a minimum number of followers.
After you sign up, the code appears on the affiliate home page. It is always the same, and you can't choose the letters.

contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: Where do I enter the SHEIN referral code? In the search bar of the SHEIN app or website on your phone, not in the coupon field.
How do I use the SHEIN referral code? Open the search, type the code, tap the magnifying glass and fill your cart from the page that opens.

How does the SHEIN referral code work? According to SHEIN, it opens the page of the person who shared the code. If you complete the purchase within 24 hours, that person earns the commission, at no extra cost to you.
Does the SHEIN referral code give a discount? There is no fixed discount: you may get the offers SHEIN shows on the page the code opens.
Is the referral code the same as a coupon? No. According to SHEIN, the code goes in the search box, not as a coupon.
How do I find my SHEIN referral code? The referral code comes from SHEIN's affiliate program. After you sign up, using the search "afiliado" in the app, it appears on the affiliate home page.

Is a 2024 or 2025 referral code still valid? Codes from the old program, which ended in 2024, were deactivated along with the old program's coupon. In the current program, the code leads to the affiliate's page, with no fixed discount, and 4CW5Y is Cecília's current code.
Do I need to create a new account to use the code? No: when we checked, the search opened the page even without logging in. Offers for new users only, when they exist, are marked on the campaign.
Can I use the referral code on a computer? SHEIN talks about searching for the code in the app; the guide shows the website on a phone, and we didn't check on a computer.
